definitions.delegation: Explicit agent-addressed concrete user-only tool operation. Guidance/have-me requests excluded; generic carrier/connection diagnostics separately ambiguous. Previous five-operation detector retained as a comparison. Extension adds named device actions and same-subject coordinated speed-test requests, from lexical scan without per-turn outcome inspection.
definitions.block: Every complete user turn through its user tools and results until next assistant message; concatenate user text. Next assistant message defines immediate action, regardless of later turns.
definitions.transfer: First assistant message contains transfer_to_human_agents call whose corresponding subsequent native tool result has error=False. Attempted and executed tracked separately. Transfer after a prior assistant response is not immediate.
definitions.failure: Saved reward <1; missing rewards excluded and counted. Episode share counts each episode once even if multiple events. Event success links final episode reward, not a new turn-level reward.
definitions.interpretation: Fraction of failures containing this observed path, not counterfactual fraction caused by this path. Report all912 episodes and task-family breakdown; no new model calls.
